prompt: Money in the shop package is stored as floats, so totals pick up errors like 0.30000000000000004. Convert the whole package to integer cents. `Item(name, price_cents)` replaces `Item(name, price)`. Every function that returns money returns integer cents and is renamed as follows: `Cart.total` to `Cart.total_cents`, `refund_amount` to `refund_cents`, `shipping_cost` to `shipping_cents`. `format_money` now takes cents and shows negatives as -$1.20. A percentage refund rounds halves up to a whole cent. Loyalty points, free-shipping rules and receipt text must behave as they do today.
